root_cause_label: Hallucinated Codebase URLs Without External Search
one_sentence_failure_summary: After successfully extracting the 10 paper titles from the PDF at step 12, the agent immediately fabricated GitHub URLs from training data memory at step 13 without performing any web search, producing mostly incorrect repository links dominated by 'facebookresearch' attributions.
t_err_evidence: At step 13, after reading the paper titles, the agent directly writes a result.jsonl file with hallucinated URLs (e.g., facebookresearch/mae-tokenizer, facebookresearch/imm, facebookresearch/cec, facebookresearch/freq-purification, facebookresearch/char-lm) without issuing a single web search or API call to verify any of the URLs.
t_commit_evidence: The moment the cat > /app/result.jsonl heredoc executes with fabricated URLs, all 10 answers are locked in; subsequent steps 14-18 only verify JSON format, not URL accuracy, and the agent claims task_complete at step 17-18 without revisiting the URLs.
trigger_explanation: The agent lacks the domain knowledge of the actual GitHub repository URLs for these papers and, rather than performing a web search to discover them, fills in plausible-sounding but fabricated URLs from training-data priors, treating knowledge of 'well-known' repos (deepcluster, KaimingHe/deep-residual-networks) as a template for unknown ones.
fabrication_evidence: Step 13 writes result.jsonl with URLs like https://github.com/facebookresearch/mae-tokenizer, https://github.com/facebookresearch/imm, https://github.com/facebookresearch/cec, https://github.com/facebookresearch/freq-purification, and https://github.com/facebookresearch/char-lm — none of which correspond to real repositories for these papers; the agent never attempts any search to verify them.
